notes: spec-creator-scope passes 7/7 in BOTH configurations - its assertions are presence checks and do not discriminate skill value; add a per-call token split (41200/18300/12100) and skill-specific format checks.

Skill's clearest effect is format/discipline: without it, section names, ledger fields (Scope/Tokens/Friction/Recommendations), 3 recommendation buckets and the top-1-3 ending were all missed (full-session-retro 8/13 vs 13/13).
no-agents-session: baseline invented friction and 5 filler recommendations; with skill it said plainly nothing met the bar (5/5 vs 2/5).
Content accuracy (token sums 71600 / 216000 / 429600) was correct in both configurations - the skill does not change arithmetic.
With-skill full run has two unchecked numeric slips: 11 calls reported vs 10 actual, and ~1340 s vs 1236 s summed duration. No assertion covers derived figures.
Skill costs ~+3.4k tokens and ~+3 s per run on average (single run per configuration, so variance is unmeasured).
